## Release to `main` — Manual Verification Gate

All items below must be manually verified against the staging/candidate build before merging to `main`.

- [ ] **Magic Link Sign In:** Sign in with a new or existing account using magic link.
- [ ] **Complete Stripe Onboarding:** Start and complete the start selling onboarding flow.
- [ ] **Create an Order:** Create an order for a listing.
- [ ] **Create a subscription:** Create a subscription for a listing.
